route_title: 22-Layer ZnS/MgF2 Dual-Band Filter with Empirical Thickness Initialization
compilation_rationale: Compiled explicit 22-layer ZnS/MgF2 alternating stack on CaF2 initialized to 950 nm nominal thickness with broad finite bounds. Gradient descent targets equal-weight mean transmittance across two passbands and two stopbands under coherent TMM. Solver smatrix resolves stack analytically.
